title: Zesty Canadian Chicken Skewers
description: A low-fat and flavorful Canadian dish featuring chicken skewers with a zesty barbeque sauce, cooked to crispy perfection in a clay pot and served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together barbeque sauce, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the preheated clay pot and cook for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Increase the temperature to 425 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and crispy.
Remove the skewers from the clay pot and serve on a wooden board.
